# Load packages
```{r}
#| include: false
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
```

# Load penguin dataset
```{r}
getwd()
penguins <- read_csv(here::here("data/penguins.csv"))
```
# Initial investigations
```{r}
head(penguins)
str(penguins)
```

# Convert chr vars to fcts
```{r}
penguins <- penguins |> 
  mutate(species = as_factor(species),
         island = as_factor(island),
         sex = as_factor(sex))
```

# Check distribution of males to females via plot
```{r}
penguins |> 
  group_by(species, sex, island) |> 
  summarise(total_count = n()) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = species, y = total_count, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Species",
       y = "Total count")
```

# Check relationship of body mass to flipper length via scatter plot
Check by species
```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Scatter plot of body mass vs flipper length by species"

penguins_scatter <- 
penguins |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = body_mass_g, y = flipper_length_mm, group = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Body mass (g)",
       y = "Flipper length (mm)")
```

```{r}
ggsave(penguins_scatter, filename = here::here("output/penguins_scatter.png"), width = 4, height = 2.5)
```
